 One dies of dengue, 1,633 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 419 as total cases reach 1,35,000 
 Published : 31 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 31 October 2026, 17:53
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least one dengue patient died and 1,633 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am today.
 The death was reported from Khulna division, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest death and new cases, the number of dengue-related deaths this year has risen to 419, while the total number of cases has reached 1,35,000.
 Currently, 6,236 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
